releases.name: v0.1.0 Initial release
v0.2.0 SageMaker launcher
v0.2.1: Patch release
v0.3.0 Notebook launcher and multi-node training
v0.4.0 Experimental DeepSpeed and multi-node CPU support
v0.5.0 Dispatch batches from main DataLoader
v0.5.1: Patch release
v0.6.0: Checkpointing and bfloat16 support
v0.6.1: Hot fix
v0.6.2: Fix launcher with mixed precision
v0.7.0: Logging API, FSDP, batch size finder and examples revamp
v0.7.1 Patch release
v0.8.0: Big model inference
v0.9.0: Refactor utils to use in Transformers
V0.10.0 DeepSpeed integration revamp and TPU speedup
v0.11.0 Gradient Accumulation and SageMaker Data Parallelism
v0.12.0 New doc, gather_for_metrics, balanced device map and M1 support
v0.13.0 Launcher update (multinode and GPU selection) and mutliple bug fixes
v0.13.1 Patch release
v0.13.2 Patch release
v0.14.0: Megatron-LM integration and support for PyTorch 1.13
v0.15.0: Pytorch 2.0 stack support
v0.16.0: Improved and Interactive Documentation, DataLoader Improvements
v0.17.0: PyTorch 2.0 support, Process Control Enhancements, TPU pod support and FP8 mixed precision training
v0.17.1: Patch release
v0.18.0: GradientState enhancements and Big Model Inference Fixes
v0.19.0: IPEX Support, Foundations for Transformers Integration, FP8 for Ada Lovelace GPUs, and Squashed Bugs
v0.20.0: MPS and fp4 support on Big Model Inference, 4-bit QLoRA, Intel GPU, Distributed Inference, and much more!
v0.20.1: Patch release
v0.20.2: Patch release
v0.20.3: Patch release
v0.21.0: Model quantization and NPUs
v0.22.0: Distributed operation framework, Gradient Accumulation enhancements, FSDP enhancements, and more!
v0.23.0: Model Memory Estimation tool, Breakpoint API, Multi-Node Notebook Launcher Support, and more!
v0.24.0: Improved Reproducability, Bug fixes, and other Small Improvements
v0.24.1: Patch Release for Samplers
v0.25.0: safetensors by default, new trackers, and plenty of bug fixes
v0.26.0 - MS-AMP Support, Critical Regression Fixes, and More
v0.26.1: Patch Release
v0.27.0: PyTorch 2.2.0 Support, PyTorch-Native Pipeline Parallism, DeepSpeed XPU support, and Bug Fixes
v0.28.0: DataLoaderConfig, XLA improvements, FSDP + QLORA foundations, Gradient Synchronization Tweaks, and Bug Fixes
v0.29.0: NUMA affinity control, MLU Support, and DeepSpeed Improvements
v0.29.1: Patchfix
v0.29.2: Patchfix
v0.29.3: Patchfix
v0.30.0: Advanced optimizer support, MoE DeepSpeed support, add upcasting for FSDP, and more
v0.30.1: Bugfixes
v0.31.0: Better support for sharded state dict with FSDP and Bugfixes
v0.32.0: Profilers, new hooks, speedups, and more!
v0.33.0: MUSA backend support and bugfixes
v0.34.0: StatefulDataLoader Support, FP8 Improvements, and PyTorch Updates!
v0.34.1 Patchfix
Accelerate 1.0.0 is here!
v1.0.1: Bugfix
v1.1.0: Python 3.9 minimum, torch dynamo deepspeed support, and bug fixes
v1.2.0: Bug Squashing & Fixes across the board
v1.2.1: Patchfix
v1.3.0 Bug fixes + Require torch 2.0
v1.4.0: `torchao` FP8, TP & dataLoader support, fix memory leak
v1.5.0: HPU support
Patch: v1.5.2
v1.6.0: FSDPv2, DeepSpeed TP and XCCL backend support
v1.7.0 : Regional compilation, Layerwise casting hook, FSDPv2 + QLoRA
v1.8.0: FSDPv2 + FP8, Regional Compilation for DeepSpeed, Faster Distributed Training on Intel CPUs, ipex.optimize deprecation
v1.8.1: Patchfix
v1.9.0: Trackio support, Model loading speedup, Minor distributed improvements
v1.10.0: N-D Parallelism
v1.10.1: Patchfix
v1.11.0: TE MXFP8, FP16/BF16 with MPS, Python 3.10
v1.12.0: Deepspeed Ulysses/ALST
v1.13.0: Neuron support, IPEX removal, and distributed training fixes
v1.14.0: AMD ROCm support, FSDP2 hardening
v1.15.0: FSDP2 activation memory, dtensor improvements
